question: Related Questions Q. Asalam alaikum, My eleder brother expired two years ago leaving behind a wife and a minor child. After some period of time recently, the widow (wife of deceased) got remarried. In this point of view we went to Darul Ifta in Hyderabad to know the Sharia Law for the child custody in such situations. They gave us saying that the Child if female shall be with mother and if male then after her remarriage the child until the age of 7 should be with the maternal grandmother if she is alive and later after 7 to the paternal grandparents if she is not alive then the custody shall be for the paternal grand parents. Now the problem is we have been seeking from the widow the custody but they are reluctant to give when we show them the fatwa they told us to keep it aside and they want to have the share from the property (the share of the widow). we have no problem in giving the share we evaluated as be the sharia law and gave the figure how much will it be and later they keep on delaying things with the intention to avoid the cutodial issue of the child. Until now the issue is pending so far we havent seek any assistance from the court. we would like to seek your kind assistance is doing the rightful. Please guide us, and show us path to safegaurd the childs mental conditions as t he mother (widow) took the child with her to his new husband. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 7382 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: My Brother-in-law had expired in 2003 survived by his mother, wife, a daughter, and two brothers (one elder and one younger ?? both married). Please advise the right division of his a) Property, b) Amount (blood money) arrange by the govt for the family. Question: Salaam Alaikum, My Brother-in-law had expired in 2003 survived by his mother, wife, a daughter, and two brothers (one elder and one younger ?? both married). Please advise the right division of his a) Property, b) Amount (blood money) arrange by the govt for the family. Please advise the division among the above mentioned family members in the light of Quran. May Allah take us to the right direction. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 7382 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1708/1510=B/1429) In the light of the Quran and Hadith, the wealth of the your brother-in-law will be distributed in 48 shares, out of which 6 shares will go to his wife, 8 shares to his mother, 24 to the daughter and the rest 10 will be distributed equally between the two brothers. (2) The amount granted by the government shall not be shared by all the heirs; rather it will go to one who will be nominated by the government. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
